asr.full_text: So by now you guys know that I'm very very bullish on the overall outlook for the RWA sector and in this video I wanted to dive into Stellar, XLM in particular. Now you guys know I'm bullish on a lot of these assets and we'll take a look at some things that really really point in the direction of institutions coming in for certain sectors of the market certain cryptos i think are going to perform extremely well but i don't think they're all going to perform well and i think it's all about positioning ourselves in the right pockets of the market right now to front run the institutional money we've seen what they're doing with money we've seen what they're doing with Bitcoin we've seen what they're doing with ethereum I believe that they're going to do this again but they're not going to do it with the entire market the institutions want a stronghold on certain assets and let me dive into exactly kind of what I'm thinking about so let me share my screen with you guys and give you guys a little bit of insight on what i'm thinking about so let me share my screen with you guys and uh give you guys a little bit of insight on what i'm thinking here so i put out this post a couple days ago actually yesterday put it out yesterday morning the top 10 altcoin gainers last 365 days now you got z cash which is burst on the scene, XRP. Then you got XLM. Right below those exchange tokens. Up 253%. But, if you look at this, it's lagging behind HBAR. It's lagging behind XRP. And XLM to me, very, very, undervalued, considering it's a top 15 crypto. It's 65% down from its all-time high right now. And it has a huge use case, massive partnerships. And people right now are really excited from a technical standpoint, from a fundamental standpoint. You know, it's really had a nice consolidation phase. Right now we've got Visa and Paxos working with Stellar XLM with stable coin integration, unlocking the future of payments. And the Federal Reserve just spotlighted Stellar for its secure scalable and efficient payment system validating its scp consensus model so you've got a lot working in stellar's favor right now and i think the price is just severely undervalued as i mentioned we got the 94 cents eight years ago back in 2018 we never got all the way up there again in 2021. Why? It was because XRP was in that lawsuit. And because XRP was in that lawsuit, it dragged down Stellar XLM too, because the same reasons why people stayed away from XRP, they stayed away from Stellar. And you know, XRP is at $159 billion market cap. It's not to say it can't perform extremely well from here it definitely can but you're looking at stellar at a 10 billion dollar market cap so the potential upside here for stellar xlm i think outweighs a lot of other assets out there in the space and you know i recently came across an article from bn crypto which is a good platform good outlet they talked about three particular real world assets tokens to watch in november 2025 and they mentioned here that the real world asset space is heating up again with talk of rate cuts and renewed investor appetite for yield several projects tied to off-chain assets are showing signs of life the sector's up six percent in the last 24 hours eight percent on the week and strong fundamentals drive some while others are driven by whale accumulation and clear chart reversals so they talked about maple finance which i've heard about before never got into this one but it could be one to kind of look into uh and then they also talked about another smaller cap play vita is another rwa token to watch in november kita's strength looks like a continuation play but then you come down to a household name that they mentioned as well, Stellar. The final RWA altcoin to watch in the coming months, standing out for its strong real-world asset growth, despite muted price action, meaning the price is not caught up to what's happening right now with Stellar. Stellar Network value tied to RWAs has reached $639 million. That's up 26.5 percent from a month ago. Yet this fundamental progress hasn't been fully reflected in the token price. So commenting on XLM's October performance, Yousef explained that institutional capital briefly rotated out of payment layer networks like Stellar and into favor and in favor of stronger yield bearing RWA tokens. But over the past week it says XLM is up 7.6 percent gradually gaining pace with the broader RWA market and over the few months, the token still has fallen 19%. On the daily, XLM trades against a long-term ascending trend line that has guided its structure since early July. The current price near 33 cents faces immediate resistance at 36 cents. Right now we're at $32 but a clear breakout above $36, all of a sudden this could create a path forward upwards to $0.41, but also the chart hints at a near term caution as well. We do look at the RSI. It's a little high right now. The hidden bearish divergence signals that momentum may be fading supporting possible short-term corrections xlm could revisit 31 cents or even 28 cents as support zones but in yusefs view breaking out of the current range will require both macro and economic ecosystem triggers rather to align we are expected to get a fed rate cut today we are expected to get a trade truce between the united states and china which could reignite risk appetite for investors especially for yield-bearing altcoins indirectly benefiting liquidity tokens like xlm that support what stable coins and cross-border payment rails so i'm really excited about the potential Stellar has moving forward. And it says here for XOM to transition from base building phase to a confirmed bullish trend, there needs to be an alignment of stable market backdrop combined with increased whale accumulation, growth in transaction volume and network usage and greater ecosystem utility. Well, we're seeing increased whale accumulation We're seeing growth in transaction volume all we really need is the macro that's what we're missing right now for I think some of the top projects to really make a move so In my estimation stellar very underrated right now You know, we're making a ton of moves over at our patreon. If you guys want to come over and join us, we've got exclusive video content, unbelievable Discord with great members in there. You could pay annually, save 15%. We even got a VIP tier where we do live calls every Friday morning, full portfolio access, buy and sell alerts. We've got it all for you over at our Patreon. Definitely come on over and check us out i would love to have you guys come over and support us and belong to the best community in all of crypto you know we spent tons of money on stuff we don't need what the hell is 17 bucks a month if it can help you change your entire financial future and that is what we're building with our private community called the inner circle so thank you guys so much for watching the video let me know your thoughts down below and we'll see you guys in the next video
